s_criteria:
• Applicable for all Malaysian students or International students that holds academic result from any institution in Malaysia.
  • Academic qualifications that are recognised includes:
  • STPM
  • UEC
  • A-Levels
  • Diploma
  • Foundation
  • AUSMAT or SACE or MUFY
  • Ontario (OSSD)
  • International Baccalaureate (IB)
s_highlights: • Recipients are only entitled to one financial aid (except loans) at Taylor’s University/College, irrespective of whether the aid is provided by Taylor’s University/College or any other body.
s_award:
• Tuition fee waiver of up to RM 12,000 per year
  • All awards are applicable for studies at Taylor's University/College in Malaysia only and are not applicable for period of study at overseas partner universities
s_details: This scholarship is awarded to students with excellent academic results in Diploma, Foundation, STPM or equivalent pre-university programmes e.g. A-Levels, UEC, SACE, MUFY, IB, Ontario (OSSD).
s_application: Consult with education counsellors to confirm on eligibility and availability of the scholarship upon registration

s_award:
Full sponsorship for preparatory course and undergraduate programme in the form of a convertible loan that covers:
  • Tuition Fee
  • Accommodation
  • Living Expenses
  • Other study cost incurred
